Rev临床实践提醒在诊治5岁及以上疑似社区获得性肺炎（CAP）的患儿时，切勿盲目依赖常规大环内酯类经验性治疗。鉴于2023-2024年支原体感染的全球大流行回升及国内极高的大环内酯类耐药率，临床医生在初始治疗效果不佳时，应尽早评估耐药风险及混合感染可能，并根据患儿实际情况调整后续的用药方案。重点概要肺炎支原体感染在非药物干预措施解除后迎来全球性大流行回升，使临床诊疗面临更严峻的挑战。2023-2024年的感染回升伴随着全球（尤其是中国）大环内酯类耐药率的攀升，显著增加了临床治疗难度。基层医疗机构诊断及监测能力的不足，导致肺炎支原体的临床管理陷入被动循环。目前基层普遍缺乏充足的核酸检测手段与耐药监测能力，且尚未建立起完善的流行病学监测网络。儿童替代治疗药物选择受限与混合感染比例增加，共同加剧了患者的疾病负担。在缺乏有效预防疫苗的背景下，这些因素使得儿童重症及难治性肺炎支原体肺炎的应对更加棘手。查看原文深度批阅神经内科神经科急诊Systematic first.标题: Learning When to Trust via Selective Context Preference Optimization
first.摘要: Language models increasingly condition their answers on external signals, and a single misleading one can turn a correct answer wrong. The obvious remedy, training models to resist such signals, hides a failure mode: a model that ignores all context looks robust yet is useless when the context is worth trusting. We recast the problem as selective trust and introduce MIST, a human-annotated benchmark that renders each reasoning item under four matched conditions (clean, misleading, correct-context, and irrelevant-context), together with SC2W, a paired metric counting how often a misleading signal flips a clean-correct answer to wrong. Across a comprehensive benchmark study, we observe that such a susceptibility is universal. We then propose SCOPE, which mines clean-correct/misleading-wrong failures and optimizes a standard Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) objective over matched preference pairs balanced equally across all four conditions, rather than over misleading items alone. Our approach substantially reduces SC2W on popular open-sourced models while preserving accuracy when the added context is clean, correct, or irrelevant. With this work, we argue that models should be judged on selective trust, not on resistance alone.
